Dear Sir/Madam 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015, we hereby inform you that the audio recording of the Earnings Call for the quarter ended 
30thJune, 2026, held today, i.e., 1st August, 2026, has been uploaded on the Company's website and 
is available at the following weblink: 
 
https://cleanscience.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Recording_of_Con_call_01082026.mp3 
  
You are requested to take the same on record.  
 
Thanking You. 
 
For Clean Science and Technology Limited
